scope: Tapering cylindrical red brick tower, irregular small windows, heavy metal entry, rounded crenellated parapet/roof deck and own narrow footings. Park monuments, outside flags/poles, adjacent museum/pavilion and buildings excluded.

inspectedLocal.caption: A view of the Phoenix Shot Tower, formerly the Merchants Shot Tower, in Baltimore's Jonestown neighborhood
inspectedLocal.inspection: Selected2015 complete tower original inspected: very tall taper, sparse alternating window faces, rounded red crown merlons, horizontal repair bands, lightning conductors and narrow dark base doorway; surrounding flags/park not part of model.

sources.inspection: Maryland Historical Trust primary record read:14storeys,40ft base diameter,20ft top diameter, thick brick shell, low doorway, sparse windows and concrete crenellated parapet.

Aerial inspected: circular flat red roof deck inside approximately16 rounded merlons, western main opening beside North Front Street and narrow own path. South low dark mark conservatively treated as closed aperture, not a second certified entrance. Neighboring pavilion/park sculptures excluded.
